description: This file defines custom Gradle tasks related to Android app build verification, specifically for generating and checking app badging information. It includes task classes, configurations, and extension functions to manage these tasks during the build process.

classes.name: GenerateBadgingTask
classes.description: Custom Gradle task to generate badging information from an APK using aapt2.

classes.name: CheckBadgingTask
classes.description: Custom Gradle task to compare generated badging info against a golden version for verification.

methods.name: taskAction
methods.description: Executes the aapt2 dump badging command and writes output to a file.

methods.name: taskAction
methods.description: Compares generated badging data with the golden copy to verify correctness.

methods.name: capitalized

methods.name: configureBadgingTasks
methods.description: Configures and registers badging-related tasks per build variant.
